I can't write `notes/same-frame.json` because I have no file-writing tool in this session. The intended content is below, and you can save it at `app/notes/same-frame.json`.

FILE: app/notes/same-frame.json
```json
{ "rejects": false, "finalRadius": 7, "finalTargetX": 5 }
```

The declarations don't include the implementation, so these values are inferred, not verified. `rejects` is false because no abort signal is passed and nothing in the declarations suggests a rejection path. `finalRadius` is 7 because the goal has no `radius`, so the later `camera.radius = 7` should stand. `finalTargetX` is the uncertain one: `goal.target` is the live `spot` object, so if the interpolator reads it on each frame it settles at 5, but if it copies the values when `interpolateArcRotateCamera` is called it settles at 1. The `camera.radius = 7` line is safe either way, but `spot.x = 5` is only safe if the interpolator copies the target, so pass a fresh object per call (for example `target: { ...spot }`) to avoid depending on that.
